## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- Stage 3 of the collaboration plan, presence (`76bbf90`, branch `collab/stage-3`).
  - **How it works:** Yjs awareness rides the comic's existing Realtime channel: a 100 ms send
    throttle, a 2 s heartbeat, and a 5 s timeout that we sweep ourselves, since y-protocols
    hard-codes 30 s. Joining asks the others to resend their state; leaving (unmount or
    `pagehide`) announces it.
  - **Soft hold:** the pure `holderOf` decides the holder (earliest claim, lower client id on a
    tie). `Transformer` claims only once a drag really starts, and snaps back if it loses a tie.
  - **Two bugs found by the e2e test:**
    - a remount loop: the text editor's attachment read the "who's moving what" lookup, so
      publishing a caret remounted TipTap, which published again. Fixed by using the plain
      balloon in the attachment, and by only rebuilding `peers` when a remote change actually
      alters it.
    - double-click never reached balloons or free panels, a bug that predates this work:
      Transformer's pointer capture makes the browser fire `dblclick` on the Transformer
      itself.
  - **Left undone (noted in the plan):** tail drags aren't held, Esc doesn't cancel a drag, and
    there are no "A. K. edited page 1" announcements.
  - 214 unit, 13 integration and 18 e2e tests pass. No migration this time.
- **Shipped stage 3** (`dpl_C2fCqNHMTKNGqGAAFWqcv1SekXNt`).
  - The first `vercel deploy --prod` failed with "Not authorized", before any upload. The login
    and team access were fine, and after `vercel whoami` the retry went through: a stale CLI
    token, most likely.
  - Checked afterwards: routes respond as before, and MCP still lists "Evaporation".
  - Not checked: presence between two real people on production. That needs Yan's second
    account.

- [Style profiles and in-app generation](../plans/2026-09-29_style-profiles-generation.plan.md),
  all five stages built on `main`. Not deployed: the Gemini and Higgsfield keys aren't in yet.
  - **Asked for:** prompting in the app, plus saved art styles (reference images, style text,
    colours) that a new comic can use.
  - **Decided with Yan:**
    - direct Gemini and Higgsfield keys rather than AI Gateway;
    - every style visible to the whole team;
    - comics live-linked to their style;
    - prompting per panel, in the Inspector.
  - **What landed:**
    - `/styles` with Describe from references (gemini-3.1-flash-lite, JSON schema);
    - a New comic dialog with a style picker, and a Style row in the Inspector;
    - `/api/generate` (Gemini, with Higgsfield's jobs polled on the server), the panel's prompt,
      and takes you can switch between;
    - three MCP tools.

    A `generations` table logs every attempt with the exact prompt. The `assets` bucket rises
    to 25 MB, because 2K PNGs can pass 10 MB.
  - **Research changed the design:**
    - models only accept fixed aspect lists, so the nearest ratio is chosen and the image fills
      the panel;
    - Higgsfield's public API has no Nano Banana, GPT Image or Seedream (they are CLI-only);
    - Higgsfield takes references as URLs, so it gets 10-minute signed links.
  - **Tests:** the fake provider (`GENERATION_PROVIDER=fake`) keeps them free. 264 unit,
    24 integration and 20 e2e tests pass.
  - **Fixed along the way:**
    - the `Plan:` trailer sat in its own paragraph, so git didn't parse it and the diary called
      every commit Unplanned. The 11 unpushed commits were rewritten; yesterday's pushed
      collaboration commits have the same fault and were left as they are.
    - a stale empty `.git/index.lock` was removed.
